用民用商用服务 Starlink 做进攻性无人机打击杀人，从未被允许，也不该被允许。

The idea that if we work hard and
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我已离开 Anthropic。过去一年多我在做 Claude Code，亲眼看着它成长到远超我想象的规模。

我很喜欢在 Ant 的工作，深信其使命，尤其是「向上竞赛」的理念。
highlights.name: Thariq
highlights.text_zh: Claude Code 核心作者 Thariq 离职 Anthropic：共事一年多，见证其规模远超想象。

highlights.excerpt: Everything is hard. Nothing works the first time. It all feels pointless. That’s when you realize you’re going to have to will it into existence with every ounce of your fucking soul. And that’s when it starts to happen.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 凡事都很难。第一次从来行不通。一切都显得毫无意义。这时你才意识到：必须用尽全身力气、凭意志把它拽进现实。然后事情才真正开始发生。
highlights.name: Alex Hormozi
highlights.text_zh: Hormozi：凡事都难、首次必败、感觉无意义——这时才要用意志把它拽进现实。

highlights.excerpt: The difference between having a tool and being a tool is subtle these days and it’s easy to accidentally build yourself into being a tool. Don’t be a tool.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 如今「拥有工具」和「成为工具」的差别很微妙，一不小心就会把自己做成工具。别当工具。
highlights.name: Tibo
highlights.text_zh: Tibo：拥有工具与成为工具的界限很细——别把自己做成工具。

highlights.excerpt: I regret to inform you that nobody cares about your potential. Potential is nothing without execution. When you're young, everyone cares about your potential. You get used to focusing on it. But as you get older, no one cares about your potential. Just your delivery against it.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 很遗憾地告诉你：没人在乎你的潜力。没有执行，潜力一文不值。年轻时人人在乎你的潜力，你也习惯盯着潜力。年纪大了，没人再在乎潜力，只看你交付了什么。
highlights.name: Sahil Bloom
highlights.text_zh: Sahil Bloom：没人在乎你的潜力，只看你交付了什么；潜力不等于执行。

highlights.excerpt:
卧槽，3090要可能要涨价了！！  

因为老黄的刀法被人破解了  

有人给3090解了个锁，同样限制在 360W，PyTorch 测试从 75 TFLOPS 跑到了 135 TFLOPS，提升约 80%！
 
 你以为是超频，把功耗往上拉？  

但他改的是显卡里控制运算速度的寄存器，这些寄存器平时有权限保护，正常改不了  

他利用 GPU
highlights.name: 铁锤人
highlights.text_zh: 3090 锁被破解：同 360W 功耗下 PyTorch 从 75 提到 135 TFLOPS，约 +80%。

highlights.excerpt:
There’ll be times where you over-guide the AI. It knows better than you and is more intelligent than you.

There’ll be times where you under-guide the AI. It can go off-track, have the wrong biases, or miss context.

How well you manage this superpower is the #0 skill I look for.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
有时你会过度引导 AI——它比你懂、比你聪明。

有时你会引导不足——它会跑偏、带错偏见或漏掉上下文。

管好这种超能力，是我招人时看的第 0 项技能。
highlights.name: Guillermo Rauch
highlights.text_zh: Rauch：管好对 AI 的过引导与欠引导，是他招人时看的第 0 技能。
